feature: Toppan download: file registered-mail DN2 (DPT-URA-DN2-D2-*) dibaca untuk mencatat nomor registrasi pos dan memajukan stage dari ACK Toppan
note: ToppanDownloadJob membaca file balasan Toppan, termasuk file registered mail DN2/RD2 yang memuat postal registration number, lalu stageTransitionService.processStageTransitions memajukan notice (DN1->DN2, DN2->DR3). Tidak ada story dalam chunk OCMS12.26-12.30 yang menyebut penerimaan balasan vendor atau nomor registrasi pos. Apakah story lain menaunginya belum dicek.
note_en: ToppanDownloadJob reads the Toppan reply files, including the DN2/RD2 registered-mail files that carry the postal registration number, and stageTransitionService.processStageTransitions then advances the notices (DN1->DN2, DN2->DR3). No story in the chunk OCMS12.26-12.30 mentions receiving vendor replies or the postal registration number. Whether another story covers it was not checked.
